PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.aromaPrinciple: [sine][gold]There is no absolute justice, but I will still call for it![/gold][/sine]
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.banter.alive.endT: Do not needlessly delay the trial. Your hesitation will only give these outlaws a moment's respite.
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.banter.dead.endTu: Even if I have fallen, the eyes of the court are still upon you... Deliver your verdict, do not delay any longer.
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.cardsModifierDesc: Penance's cards will now appear in card rewards and the shop.
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.description:
A judge from Syracusa, bearing the shadows of the past and the weight of the law.
Since the law cannot reach this Spire, she becomes the embodiment of order, cutting through thorns to defend the path.
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.eventDeathPrevent: They and the darkness behind them may occasionally gain the upper hand... but even the most bothersome rainy season will eventually pass.
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.goldMonologue: [sine]Perhaps this fortune will be enough to rebuild the riddled judicial system of the New Volsinii...[/sine]
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.title: Penance
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.unlockText: Play a run with [pink]{Prerequisite}[/pink] to unlock this character.
